title: Make broad capability comparisons reliable acceptance evidence
scope: Strengthen the audit probe so each comparison has explicit normalization, coverage and stage boundaries.
acceptance: Keep default-only, non-default, blocked and source/target consumer failures separate in counts and stored evidence.
For the new implementation tickets, provide focused exact-path assertions and avoid accepting unrelated raw differences as blanket waivers.
Add sensitivity checks for representative missing-property faults and document the evidence needed before a probe result can close a ticket.
exclusions: Do not require every existing raw layout/default difference to disappear before a scoped feature can land.

reproduction.instructions: Keep default-only, non-default, blocked and source/target consumer failures separate in counts and stored evidence.
